# Four-Layer Implementation Example - Audio Module
# This shows exactly how each layer builds on the previous one

## ============================================================================
## LAYER 1: Raw Bindings (android/raw/ndk/aaudio.nim)
## ============================================================================
# Generated by Futhark or your JNI tool - direct 1:1 mappings

when defined(android):
  # NDK Raw Bindings - Direct C function imports
  type
    AAudioStreamBuilder* {.importc, header: "aaudio/AAudio.h".} = object
    AAudioStream* {.importc, header: "aaudio/AAudio.h".} = object
    aaudio_result_t* {.importc, header: "aaudio/AAudio.h".} = int32
    aaudio_direction_t* {.importc, header: "aaudio/AAudio.h".} = int32

  const
    AAUDIO_OK* {.importc, header: "aaudio/AAudio.h".} = 0
    AAUDIO_DIRECTION_OUTPUT* {.importc, header: "aaudio/AAudio.h".} = 0
    AAUDIO_DIRECTION_INPUT* {.importc, header: "aaudio/AAudio.h".} = 1

  # Raw function imports
  proc AAudioStreamBuilder_new*(): ptr AAudioStreamBuilder {.importc, dynlib: "aaudio".}
  proc AAudioStreamBuilder_setDirection*(builder: ptr AAudioStreamBuilder, direction: aaudio_direction_t) {.importc, dynlib: "aaudio".}
  proc AAudioStreamBuilder_setSampleRate*(builder: ptr AAudioStreamBuilder, sampleRate: int32) {.importc, dynlib: "aaudio".}
  proc AAudioStreamBuilder_openStream*(builder: ptr AAudioStreamBuilder, stream: ptr ptr AAudioStream): aaudio_result_t {.importc, dynlib: "aaudio".}
  proc AAudioStream_requestStart*(stream: ptr AAudioStream): aaudio_result_t {.importc, dynlib: "aaudio".}
  proc AAudioStream_write*(stream: ptr AAudioStream, buffer: pointer, frames: int32, timeoutNanos: int64): int32 {.importc, dynlib: "aaudio".}
  proc AAudioStream_close*(stream: ptr AAudioStream): aaudio_result_t {.importc, dynlib: "aaudio".}

## LAYER 1: Raw Bindings (android/raw/sdk/audio.nim) 
## ============================================================================
# Generated by your JNI tool - Java SDK bindings

when defined(android):
  import jnim # Your JNI tool
  
  # Java AudioManager bindings
  jclass AudioManager* of JVMObject:
    proc getStreamVolume*(streamType: jint): jint
    proc setStreamVolume*(streamType, index, flags: jint)
    proc getStreamMaxVolume*(streamType: jint): jint
    proc isMusicActive*(): jboolean
    
  jclass AudioTrack* of JVMObject:
    proc new*(streamType, sampleRate, channelConfig, audioFormat, bufferSize, mode: jint)
    proc play*()
    proc pause*()
    proc stop*()
    proc write*(audioData: jbyteArray, offsetInBytes, sizeInBytes: jint): jint

## ============================================================================
## LAYER 2: Safe Wrappers (android/safe/ndk/audio.nim)
## ============================================================================
# Runtime checks + proper error handling

import ../raw/ndk/aaudio
import ../../core

type
  AudioError* = object of AndroidError
    aaudioResult*: aaudio_result_t

  SafeAAudioStream* = ref object
    stream: ptr AAudioStream
    isOpen: bool
    sampleRate: int32

proc createAAudioStream*(sampleRate: int32 = 44100): Result[SafeAAudioStream, AudioError] =
  ## Create AAudio stream with safety checks
  
  # Check API level first
  if getApiLevel() < 26:
    return err(AudioError(kind: aekApiTooOld, msg: "AAudio requires API 26+"))
  
  # Create builder
  let builder = AAudioStreamBuilder_new()
  if builder == nil:
    return err(AudioError(kind: aekInitFailed, msg: "Failed to create AAudio builder"))
  
  # Configure builder
  AAudioStreamBuilder_setDirection(builder, AAUDIO_DIRECTION_OUTPUT)
  AAudioStreamBuilder_setSampleRate(builder, sampleRate)
  
  # Open stream
  var stream: ptr AAudioStream
  let result = AAudioStreamBuilder_openStream(builder, stream.addr)
  
  if result != AAUDIO_OK:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekRuntimeError, 
      msg: "Failed to open AAudio stream",
      aaudioResult: result
    ))
  
  # Success
  ok(SafeAAudioStream(
    stream: stream,
    isOpen: true,
    sampleRate: sampleRate
  ))

proc play*(safeStream: SafeAAudioStream): Result[void, AudioError] =
  ## Start playback with error handling
  if not safeStream.isOpen:
    return err(AudioError(kind: aekNotInitialized, msg: "Stream not open"))
  
  let result = AAudioStream_requestStart(safeStream.stream)
  if result != AAUDIO_OK:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekRuntimeError,
      msg: "Failed to start AAudio stream",
      aaudioResult: result
    ))
  
  ok()

proc write*(safeStream: SafeAAudioStream, buffer: seq[byte]): Result[int32, AudioError] =
  ## Write audio data with safety checks
  if not safeStream.isOpen:
    return err(AudioError(kind: aekNotInitialized, msg: "Stream not open"))
  
  if buffer.len == 0:
    return err(AudioError(kind: aekInvalidParam, msg: "Empty buffer"))
  
  let framesWritten = AAudioStream_write(
    safeStream.stream, 
    buffer[0].unsafeAddr, 
    buffer.len.int32 div 4, # Assuming 32-bit samples
    0 # No timeout
  )
  
  if framesWritten < 0:
    return err(AudioError(
      kind: aekRuntimeError,
      msg: "AAudio write failed",
      aaudioResult: framesWritten
    ))
  
  ok(framesWritten)

proc close*(safeStream: SafeAAudioStream) =
  ## Safe close with cleanup
  if safeStream.isOpen:
    discard AAudioStream_close(safeStream.stream)
    safeStream.isOpen = false

## ============================================================================
## LAYER 2: Safe Wrappers (android/safe/sdk/audio.nim)
## ============================================================================

import ../raw/sdk/audio
import ../../core

type
  SafeAudioManager* = ref object
    javaManager: AudioManager
    context: AndroidContext

  SafeAudioTrack* = ref object
    javaTrack: AudioTrack
    isInitialized: bool

proc createAudioManager*(context: AndroidContext): Result[SafeAudioManager, AudioError] =
  ## Create safe AudioManager wrapper
  if context.jniEnv == nil:
    return err(AudioError(kind: aekNoContext, msg: "No JNI context available"))
  
  try:
    # Get system service through JNI
    let manager = getSystemService(context, "audio").AudioManager
    ok(SafeAudioManager(javaManager: manager, context: context))
  except:
    err(AudioError(kind: aekJniError, msg: getCurrentExceptionMsg()))

proc createAudioTrack*(manager: SafeAudioManager, sampleRate: int32): Result[SafeAudioTrack, AudioError] =
  ## Create safe AudioTrack
  try:
    let track = AudioTrack.new(
      3, # STREAM_MUSIC
      sampleRate,
      12, # CHANNEL_OUT_STEREO  
      2,  # ENCODING_PCM_16BIT
      8192, # Buffer size
      1   # MODE_STREAM
    )
    ok(SafeAudioTrack(javaTrack: track, isInitialized: true))
  except:
    err(AudioError(kind: aekJniError, msg: getCurrentExceptionMsg()))

## ============================================================================
## LAYER 3: Idiomatic APIs (android/idiomatic/ndk/audio.nim)
## ============================================================================
# Nim-style APIs for specific implementations

import ../../safe/ndk/audio
import ../../core

type
  NdkAudioManager* = ref object
    runtime: AndroidRuntime
    activeStreams: seq[AAudioEngine]

  AAudioEngine* = ref object
    safeStream: SafeAAudioStream
    isPlaying: bool
    sampleRate: int32
    volume: float32

proc newNdkAudioManager*(runtime: AndroidRuntime): NdkAudioManager =
  ## Create NDK audio manager
  NdkAudioManager(runtime: runtime, activeStreams: @[])

proc createEngine*(manager: NdkAudioManager, sampleRate = 44100): AAudioEngine =
  ## Create AAudio engine with Nim-style API
  let streamResult = createAAudioStream(sampleRate)
  
  case streamResult
  of ok(stream):
    let engine = AAudioEngine(
      safeStream: stream,
      isPlaying: false,
      sampleRate: sampleRate,
      volume: 1.0
    )
    manager.activeStreams.add(engine)
    return engine
    
  of err(error):
    raise newException(AudioError, error.msg)

proc play*(engine: AAudioEngine, buffer: AudioBuffer) =
  ## Play audio buffer - idiomatic Nim style
  if not engine.isPlaying:
    let startResult = engine.safeStream.play()
    case startResult
    of ok(): engine.isPlaying = true
    of err(error): raise newException(AudioError, error.msg)
  
  # Apply volume
  var volumeBuffer = buffer.data
  if engine.volume != 1.0:
    for i in 0..<volumeBuffer.len:
      volumeBuffer[i] = (volumeBuffer[i].float32 * engine.volume).byte
  
  let writeResult = engine.safeStream.write(volumeBuffer)
  case writeResult
  of ok(framesWritten): discard # Success
  of err(error): raise newException(AudioError, error.msg)

proc setVolume*(engine: AAudioEngine, volume: float32) =
  ## Set playback volume (0.0 to 1.0)
  engine.volume = clamp(volume, 0.0, 1.0)

proc stop*(engine: AAudioEngine) =
  ## Stop playback
  engine.isPlaying = false
  # AAudio doesn't have explicit stop, just pause writing

proc close*(engine: AAudioEngine) =
  ## Close engine and cleanup
  engine.safeStream.close()

proc close*(manager: NdkAudioManager) =
  ## Close all engines
  for engine in manager.activeStreams:
    engine.close()
  manager.activeStreams.setLen(0)

## ============================================================================
## LAYER 3: Idiomatic APIs (android/idiomatic/sdk/audio.nim)
## ============================================================================

import ../../safe/sdk/audio
import ../../core

type
  SdkAudioManager* = ref object
    runtime: AndroidRuntime
    safeManager: SafeAudioManager
    activeTracks: seq[JavaAudioEngine]

  JavaAudioEngine* = ref object
    safeTrack: SafeAudioTrack
    isPlaying: bool
    volume: float32

proc newSdkAudioManager*(runtime: AndroidRuntime): SdkAudioManager =
  ## Create SDK audio manager
  let managerResult = createAudioManager(runtime.context.get())
  
  case managerResult
  of ok(manager):
    SdkAudioManager(
      runtime: runtime,
      safeManager: manager,
      activeTracks: @[]
    )
  of err(error):
    raise newException(AudioError, error.msg)

proc createEngine*(manager: SdkAudioManager, sampleRate = 44100): JavaAudioEngine =
  ## Create Java AudioTrack engine
  let trackResult = manager.safeManager.createAudioTrack(sampleRate)
  
  case trackResult
  of ok(track):
    let engine = JavaAudioEngine(
      safeTrack: track,
      isPlaying: false,
      volume: 1.0
    )
    manager.activeTracks.add(engine)
    return engine
    
  of err(error):
    raise newException(AudioError, error.msg)

# Similar play/stop/volume methods as NDK version...

## ============================================================================
## LAYER 4: Unified Smart API (android/audio.nim)
## ============================================================================
# Automatic implementation selection based on compile-time feature tracking

import idiomatic/ndk/audio as ndk_audio
import idiomatic/sdk/audio as sdk_audio
import core

type
  # The engine type is determined at compile time!
  AudioEngine* = ref object
    runtime: AndroidRuntime
    case kind: AudioEngineKind
    of aekNdk:
      when afAudio in usedFeatures or afLowLatencyAudio in usedFeatures:
        ndkManager: NdkAudioManager
        ndkEngine: AAudioEngine
    of aekSdk:
      when afAudio in usedFeatures and needsJavaSDK:
        sdkManager: SdkAudioManager
        sdkEngine: JavaAudioEngine

  AudioEngineKind = enum
    aekNdk, aekSdk

# Global manager instances - created at compile time based on usage!
var audioManager {.global.}: AudioEngine

proc initAudioManager(runtime: AndroidRuntime): AudioEngine =
  ## Initialize the optimal audio engine based on compile-time analysis
  new(result)
  result.runtime = runtime
  
  # This selection happens at COMPILE TIME based on tracked features!
  when afLowLatencyAudio in usedFeatures:
    # User wants low latency - prefer NDK
    if runtime.apiLevel >= 26:
      echo "🎵 Initializing AAudio (low latency)"
      result.kind = aekNdk
      result.ndkManager = newNdkAudioManager(runtime)
      result.ndkEngine = result.ndkManager.createEngine()
    elif runtime.context.isSome:
      echo "🎵 Initializing AudioTrack (fallback from AAudio)"
      result.kind = aekSdk
      result.sdkManager = newSdkAudioManager(runtime)
      result.sdkEngine = result.sdkManager.createEngine()
    else:
      raise newException(UnsupportedError, "No audio implementation available")
  
  elif afAudio in usedFeatures:
    # Basic audio - choose based on runtime mode and capabilities
    case runtime.mode
    of armNdkOnly:
      if runtime.apiLevel >= 26:
        echo "🎵 Initializing AAudio (NDK mode)"
        result.kind = aekNdk
        result.ndkManager = newNdkAudioManager(runtime)
        result.ndkEngine = result.ndkManager.createEngine()
      else:
        raise newException(UnsupportedError, "NDK audio not available on API < 26")
    
    of armSdkOnly:
      if runtime.context.isSome:
        echo "🎵 Initializing AudioTrack (SDK mode)"
        result.kind = aekSdk
        result.sdkManager = newSdkAudioManager(runtime)
        result.sdkEngine = result.sdkManager.createEngine()
      else:
        raise newException(UnsupportedError, "SDK audio requires Java context")
    
    of armHybrid, armAuto:
      # Choose best available
      if runtime.apiLevel >= 26:
        echo "🎵 Initializing AAudio (hybrid - best performance)"
        result.kind = aekNdk
        result.ndkManager = newNdkAudioManager(runtime)
        result.ndkEngine = result.ndkManager.createEngine()
      elif runtime.context.isSome:
        echo "🎵 Initializing AudioTrack (hybrid - fallback)"
        result.kind = aekSdk
        result.sdkManager = newSdkAudioManager(runtime)
        result.sdkEngine = result.sdkManager.createEngine()
      else:
        raise newException(UnsupportedError, "No audio implementation available")

proc getAudioManager*(): AudioEngine =
  ## Get the global audio manager instance
  if audioManager == nil:
    raise newException(ValueError, "Audio manager not initialized")
  return audioManager

# Public API - automatically routes to the right implementation
proc play*(buffer: AudioBuffer) =
  ## Play audio using the optimal engine (determined at compile time!)
  trackFeature(afAudio)
  
  let manager = getAudioManager()
  case manager.kind
  of aekNdk:
    when afAudio in usedFeatures or afLowLatencyAudio in usedFeatures:
      manager.ndkEngine.play(buffer)
  of aekSdk:
    when afAudio in usedFeatures and needsJavaSDK:
      manager.sdkEngine.play(buffer)

proc playLowLatency*(buffer: AudioBuffer) =
  ## Play audio with low latency (automatically uses AAudio if available)
  trackFeature(afLowLatencyAudio)
  
  let manager = getAudioManager()
  # This will only compile if low latency features are actually used!
  when afLowLatencyAudio in usedFeatures:
    case manager.kind
    of aekNdk: manager.ndkEngine.play(buffer)
    of aekSdk: 
      # SDK doesn't have true low latency, but still works
      manager.sdkEngine.play(buffer)

proc setVolume*(volume: float32) =
  ## Set audio volume
  let manager = getAudioManager()
  case manager.kind
  of aekNdk:
    when afAudio in usedFeatures or afLowLatencyAudio in usedFeatures:
      manager.ndkEngine.setVolume(volume)
  of aekSdk:
    when afAudio in usedFeatures and needsJavaSDK:
      manager.sdkEngine.setVolume(volume)

## ============================================================================
## INITIALIZATION SYSTEM (android/core.nim)
## ============================================================================

# This is called automatically when Android runtime is initialized
proc initializeAudioSubsystem*(runtime: AndroidRuntime) =
  ## Initialize audio subsystem based on compile-time feature detection
  when afAudio in usedFeatures or afLowLatencyAudio in usedFeatures:
    audioManager = initAudioManager(runtime)
  else:
    # Audio not used - no initialization needed!
    discard

## ============================================================================
## USAGE EXAMPLES
## ============================================================================

# Example 1: Simple usage - system automatically selects best implementation
proc simpleExample() =
  # Just use the API - everything is automatic!
  let buffer = loadAudioBuffer("sound.wav")
  play(buffer)  # Automatically uses AAudio or AudioTrack based on device
  
  setVolume(0.8)

# Example 2: Low latency usage - system ensures AAudio is used
proc lowLatencyExample() =
  let buffer = loadAudioBuffer("music.wav")
  playLowLatency(buffer)  # Forces AAudio usage, fallback to AudioTrack if needed

# Example 3: Direct engine access for advanced users
proc advancedExample() =
  let manager = getAudioManager()
  
  # Check what implementation was selected
  case manager.kind
  of aekNdk:
    echo "Using NDK AAudio - Low latency available!"
    when afAudio in usedFeatures:
      # Direct access to NDK engine
      manager.ndkEngine.setVolume(1.0)
  of aekSdk:
    echo "Using SDK AudioTrack - Standard latency"
    when afAudio in usedFeatures and needsJavaSDK:
      # Direct access to SDK engine  
      manager.sdkEngine.setVolume(1.0)

# The beauty: Same code works everywhere, optimal implementation selected automatically!
